title: BOSU NEXGEN BYOB Balance Trainer, Cosmic Ash/Retro Blue

comparisons.notes: Manufacturer's BYOB NEXGEN Home Balance Trainer with Cosmic Ash dome and Retro Blue rim option; same 65 cm / 25.5 in dome, 300 lb max load, 4 textured quadrants, made in USA. Regular price $159.99, in stock.

writeup: Woot has the BOSU NEXGEN build-your-own balance trainer in Cosmic Ash and Retro Blue, new, for $49.99. BOSU's own site charges $159.99 for the same build-your-own trainer, so this is about 68% less. It has a 25.5 inch textured quadrant dome, holds up to 300 lb and is made in the USA. Only one was left when we checked, with a limit of three per customer.
amazon_match_notes: ASIN from verified price check payload; exact Cosmic Ash/Retro Blue BYOB trainer, MPN 72-10850NG-BLKMIL, UPC 810077190487
